abyssal_blade.desc_loc:
Active: Overwhelm

Stuns a target enemy unit for %stun_duration% seconds.

Pierces Debuff Immunity.

Passive: Bash

Grants melee heroes a %bash_chance_melee%%% chance on hit to stun the target for %bash_duration% seconds and deal %bonus_chance_damage% bonus physical damage. Bash chance for ranged heroes is %bash_chance_ranged%%%.
abyssal_blade.lore_loc: The lost blade of the Commander of the Abyss, this edge cuts into an enemy's soul.
abyssal_blade.name: item_abyssal_blade
notes_loc: The stun is melee range.
Does not stack with other bashes, and does not grant bash to Clones and Tempest Doubles.
Multiple sources of damage block do not stack.
The following heroes cannot trigger Bash on this item: Spirit Breaker, Faceless Void, Slardar, and Kez while in Sai mode.

aegis.desc_loc:
Passive: Reincarnation

Brings you to life with full health and mana %reincarnate_time% seconds after you die, at the location where you died.

Reincarnation must be used within %disappear_time_minutes_tooltip% minutes or Aegis of the Immortal disappears. If it expires, it will heal you over 5 seconds (dispels on damage).
aegis.lore_loc: The Immortal was said to own a shield that protected him from death itself.
aegis.name: item_aegis
notes_loc: Pronounced as ayy jis.

aeon_disk.desc_loc:
Passive: Combo Breaker

When you take damage and your health falls below %health_threshold_pct%%%, a strong dispel is applied and you gain a %buff_duration% second buff that provides +%status_resistance%%% Status Resistance and causes all damage you deal and are dealt to be reduced to zero. Only triggers on player based damage. Cooldown increases every time it triggers.

Dispel Type: Strong Dispel
aeon_disk.lore_loc: A powerful artifact long ago smuggled out of the Ivory Incubarium. Or so many believe.
aeon_disk.name: item_aeon_disk

aether_lens.lore_loc: Polished with the incantation of his final breath, the gift of a dying mage to his sickly son.
aether_lens.name: item_aether_lens
notes_loc: Cast Range bonuses from Aether Lens and Dagon do not stack.

ancient_janggo.desc_loc:
Active: Endurance

Gives +%bonus_attack_speed_pct% attack speed and +%bonus_movement_speed_pct%%% movement speed to nearby allies for %duration% seconds.

Radius: %radius%

Passive: Swiftness Aura

Grants %aura_movement_speed% movement speed and %aura_health_regen% health regeneration to allies.

Radius: %radius%
ancient_janggo.lore_loc: A relic that enchants the bodies of those around it for swifter movement in times of crisis.
ancient_janggo.name: item_ancient_janggo

angels_demise.desc_loc:
Passive: Empower Spell

The next Unit Target spell you cast on an enemy deals a separate %bonus_spell_damage% additional damage, disables their passives, and slows their movement speed by %slow%%% for %slow_duration%s.
angels_demise.lore_loc: A blade sharp enough to slice through magic itself.
angels_demise.name: item_angels_demise
notes_loc: The slow debuff is dispellable.
The break debuff is not dispellable.

arcane_blink.desc_loc:
Active: Arcane Blink

Teleport to a target point up to %blink_range% units away.

After teleportation, you restore %heal_amount% health and %mana_amount% mana.

Arcane Blink cannot be used for %blink_damage_cooldown% seconds after taking damage from an enemy hero or Roshan.
arcane_blink.lore_loc: A revitalizing tool to help bear the weight of arcane expenditure.
arcane_blink.name: item_arcane_blink
notes_loc: Self-casting will cause you to teleport in the direction of your team's fountain.

arcane_boots.desc_loc:
Active: Replenish

Restores %replenish_amount% mana to all nearby allies.

Radius: %replenish_radius%

Passive: Basilius Aura

Grants %aura_mana_regen% mana regeneration to allies.

Radius: %aura_radius% Movement speed bonuses from multiple pairs of boots do not stack.
arcane_boots.lore_loc: Magi equipped with these boots are valued in battle.
arcane_boots.name: item_arcane_boots
notes_loc: Does not work on Meepo clones.

armlet.desc_loc:
Toggle: Unholy Strength

When active, Unholy Strength grants +%unholy_bonus_damage% damage, +%unholy_bonus_strength% strength and +%unholy_bonus_armor% armor, but drains %unholy_health_drain_per_second% health per second.

You cannot die from the health drain when Unholy Strength is activated, nor from the strength loss when Unholy Strength is deactivated.
armlet.lore_loc: Weapon of choice among brutes, the bearer sacrifices his life energy to gain immense strength and power.
armlet.name: item_armlet
notes_loc: The strength change will affect both maximum and current HP, but you cannot die from the change.
The strength change occurs over 0.6 seconds.
Activating or deactivating Unholy Strength does not interrupt channeling.

assault.desc_loc:
Passive: Assault Aura

Grants %aura_attack_speed% attack speed and %aura_positive_armor% armor to nearby allied units and structures, and decreases nearby enemy unit and structure armor by %aura_negative_armor%.

Radius: %aura_radius%
assault.lore_loc: Forged in the depths of the nether reaches, this hellish mail provides an army with increased armor and attack speed.
assault.name: item_assault

basher.desc_loc:
Passive: Bash

Grants melee heroes a %bash_chance_melee%%% chance on hit to stun the target for %bash_duration% seconds and deal %bonus_chance_damage% bonus physical damage. Bash chance for ranged heroes is %bash_chance_ranged%%%.
basher.lore_loc: A feared weapon in the right hands, this maul's ability to shatter the defenses of its opponents should not be underestimated.
basher.name: item_basher
notes_loc: Does not stack with other sources of Bash.
The following heroes cannot trigger Bash on this item: Spirit Breaker, Faceless Void, Slardar, and Kez while in Sai mode.
Does not grant Bash to Clones and Tempest Doubles.

bfury.desc_loc:
Active: Chop Tree

Destroy a target tree.

Passive: Quell

Increases attack damage against non-hero units by %quelling_bonus% for melee heroes, and %quelling_bonus_ranged% for ranged.

Passive: Cleave

Deals %cleave_damage_percent%%% of attack damage as physical damage in a cone up to %cleave_distance% around the target. Deals %cleave_damage_percent_creep%%% against creeps. (Melee Only)
bfury.lore_loc: The bearer of this mighty axe gains the ability to cut down swaths of enemies at once.
bfury.name: item_bfury
notes_loc: Cleave damage goes through spell immunity.
If multiple sources of Cleave are present, each Cleave's damage is applied separately.

black_king_bar.desc_loc:
Active: Avatar

Applies a basic dispel. Grants %spell_reduce%%% magic resistance and immunity to reflected and pure damage. For the duration of the effect, any negative effect from enemy spells has no effect.

Duration: %duration%s
Dispel Type: Basic Dispel
black_king_bar.lore_loc: A powerful staff imbued with the strength of giants.
black_king_bar.name: item_black_king_bar
notes_loc: Purchasing another Black King Bar will not reset its immunity duration.
Avatar duration is not affected by increases to buff duration.

blade_mail.desc_loc:
Active: Damage Return

For %duration% seconds, return all incoming damage, increasing the percentage by %active_reflection_pct%%%.

Passive: Damage Return

Everytime you are attacked, you return %passive_reflection_constant% damage plus %passive_reflection_pct%%% of the attack damage dealt to you.
blade_mail.lore_loc: A razor-sharp coat of mail, it is the choice of selfless martyrs in combat.
blade_mail.name: item_blade_mail
notes_loc: Damage Return is calculated before any kind of reduction.
Returned damage type is the same as it was received.
Damage done by this item is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.

blight_stone.desc_loc:
Passive: Lesser Corruption

Your attacks reduce the target's armor by %corruption_armor% for %corruption_duration% seconds.
blight_stone.lore_loc: An unnerving stone unearthed beneath the Fields of Endless Carnage.
blight_stone.name: item_blight_stone
notes_loc: Does not stack with its upgrades, Desolator, or Stygian Desolator.

blink.desc_loc:
Active: Blink

Teleport to a target point up to %blink_range% units away.

Blink Dagger cannot be used for %blink_damage_cooldown% seconds after taking damage from an enemy hero or Roshan.
blink.lore_loc: The fabled dagger used by the fastest assassin ever to walk the lands.
blink.name: item_blink
notes_loc: Self-casting will cause you to teleport in the direction of your team's fountain.

blood_grenade.desc_loc:
Use: Throw Grenade

Throw a grenade at the target area. Enemies in the area will take %impact_damage% damage on impact, and be slowed by %movespeed_slow%%% and take %damage_over_time% damage every %tick_rate%s for %debuff_duration% seconds. Radius %radius%.
blood_grenade.lore_loc: Both the hunter and the hunted must pay the blood price.
blood_grenade.name: item_blood_grenade

bloodstone.desc_loc:
Active: Bloodpact

Increases Bloodstone's Spell Lifesteal to %spell_lifesteal_while_active%%%. Lasts %buff_duration% seconds.

Passive: Spell Weakness Aura

Enemy units take %aura_spell_vulnerability%%% increased damage from spells.

Radius: %aura_radius%
bloodstone.lore_loc: The Bloodstone's bright ruby color is unmistakable on the battlefield, as the owner seems to have infinite vitality and spirit.
bloodstone.name: item_bloodstone
notes_loc: Spell Weakness Aura does not stack with Veil of Discord's Spell Weakness.

bloodthorn.desc_loc:
Active: Soul Rend

Silences a target for %silence_duration% seconds. At the end of the silence, an additional %silence_damage_percent%%% of all damage taken during the silence will be dealt to the target as magical damage.

All attacks on the silenced target will deal additional damage equal to %proc_damage_heroes% if the attacker is a hero, and %proc_damage_creeps%, if the attacker is a creep. Provides True Strike for your attacks and attacks from your controlled units against the silenced target.

Passive: Pierce

Grants each attack a %proc_chance%%% chance to pierce through evasion and deal %passive_proc_damage% bonus magical damage.
bloodthorn.lore_loc: A reviled blade that bites deeper with each wriggle of its victim's final throes.
bloodthorn.name: item_bloodthorn

boots_of_bearing.desc_loc:
Active: Endurance

Gives +%bonus_attack_speed_pct% attack speed and +%bonus_movement_speed_pct%%% movement speed to nearby allies for %duration% seconds. For the first %bonus_ms_duration% seconds allies are immune to slows.

Radius: %radius%

Passive: Swiftness Aura

Grants %aura_movement_speed% movement speed and %aura_health_regen% health regeneration to allies.

Radius: %radius% Movement speed bonuses from multiple pairs of boots do not stack.
boots_of_bearing.lore_loc: Resplendent footwear fashioned for the ancient herald that first dared spread the glory of Stonehall beyond the original borders of its nascent claim.
boots_of_bearing.name: item_boots_of_bearing

bottle.desc_loc:
Active: Regenerate

Consumes a charge to restore %health_restore% health and %mana_restore% mana over %restore_time% seconds. If the hero is attacked by an enemy hero or Roshan, the effect is lost.

The Bottle automatically refills at the fountain.

Hold Control to use on an allied hero.

Passive: Store Rune

Runes can be stored in the Bottle for later use by right-clicking them. Unused runes will automatically activate after 90 seconds.

Using a stored rune fully refills the Bottle.
bottle.lore_loc: An old bottle that survived the ages, the contents placed inside become enchanted.
bottle.name: item_bottle
notes_loc: Bottle is shareable. Stored runes cannot be shared.
Using a stored Bounty or Water rune fully refills the bottle if the bottle was full when the rune was stored; otherwise, it refills two charges.

bracer.lore_loc: The bracer is a common choice to toughen up defenses and increase longevity.
bracer.name: item_bracer

buckler.desc_loc:
Passive: Buckler Aura

Grants %bonus_aoe_armor% armor to allied player units.

Radius: %bonus_aoe_radius%
buckler.lore_loc: A powerful shield that imbues the bearer with the strength of heroes past, it is capable of protecting entire armies in battle.
buckler.name: item_buckler

butterfly.lore_loc: Only the mightiest and most experienced of warriors can wield the Butterfly, but it provides incredible dexterity in combat.
butterfly.name: item_butterfly
notes_loc: Stacks diminishingly with other sources of Evasion.

cheese.desc_loc:
Use: Fondue

Instantly restores %health_restore% health and %mana_restore% mana.
cheese.lore_loc: Made from the milk of a long lost Furbolg vendor, it restores the vitality of those who taste it.
cheese.name: item_cheese
notes_loc: Cheese is shareable.

clarity.desc_loc:
Use: Replenish

Grants %mana_regen% mana regeneration to the target for %buff_duration% seconds.

If the unit is attacked by an enemy hero or Roshan, the effect is lost.
clarity.lore_loc: Clear water that enhances the ability to meditate.
clarity.name: item_clarity

consecrated_wraps.desc_loc:
Passive: Hallowed

Gain a charge every %AbilityChargeRestoreTime%s, up to a maximum of %AbilityCharges% charges. Upon gaining a charge, your movement speed is increased by %movement_speed_pct_on_stack_gain%%% for %duration%s.

Whenever you take damage from a player-controlled source or Roshan, consume all charges to gain an all damage barrier for %duration%s that absorbs %barrier_per_stack% damage per charge (%max_barrier_tooltip% max).
consecrated_wraps.name: item_consecrated_wraps
notes_loc: Charges cannot be gained for %AbilityChargeRestoreTime%s after you take damage from a player-controlled source or Roshan.
Self-damage and HP Loss damage cannot remove charges.
Movement speed buff does not stack.

crellas_crozier.desc_loc:
Active: Rite of Rumusque

You enter ghost form for %duration% seconds, becoming immune to physical damage, but are unable to attack and %extra_spell_damage_percent%%% more vulnerable to magic damage.

Steal %movespeed_steal_pct%%% movement speed from enemy heroes in %active_radius% range every second. Movement speed steal lasts %stack_duration%s.

Putrefaction Aura's effect is increased to %active_health_steal%%%. All of the lost Health Restoration is redirected to you every second.

Passive: Putrefaction Aura

Reduces nearby enemy heroes' Health Restoration by %health_steal%%%.

Radius: %radius%
crellas_crozier.name: item_crellas_crozier
notes_loc: Ghost form ends if you become Debuff Immune and will have no effect if you are already Debuff Immune.
Shares cooldown with Ghost Scepter and its upgrades.
Putrefaction Aura does not redirect Health Restoration from enemy heroes that are at full health.

crimson_guard.desc_loc:
Active: Guard

For %duration% seconds, grant nearby allied heroes and buildings a %block_chance_active%%% chance to block damage equal to %block_damage_active% plus %max_hp_pct%%% of the caster's max health value from each incoming attack.

Radius: %bonus_aoe_radius%

Passive: Damage Block

Grants a %block_chance%%% chance to block %block_damage_melee% damage from incoming attacks on melee heroes, and %block_damage_ranged% damage on ranged.
crimson_guard.lore_loc: A cuirass originally built to protect against the dreaded Year Beast.
crimson_guard.name: item_crimson_guard
notes_loc: Multiple sources of damage block do not stack.
When the Guard buff is applied to ranged heroes, Guard blocks %block_penalty_ranged% less damage.
Guard does not affect units that have been affected by Guard within Crimson Guard's cooldown.

cyclone.desc_loc:
Active: Cyclone

Sweeps a target unit up into a cyclone, making them invulnerable for %cyclone_duration% seconds. Cyclone can only be cast on enemy units or yourself.

Enemy units take %tooltip_drop_damage% magical damage upon landing.
Dispel Type: Basic Dispel
cyclone.lore_loc: A mysterious scepter passed down through the ages, its disruptive winds can be used for good or evil.
cyclone.name: item_cyclone
notes_loc: You cannot cyclone allies.
Cyclones cast on yourself go through spell immunity.
Cyclone can dispel some buffs and debuffs.
Cyclone duration is unaffected by status resistance.

dagon.desc_loc:
Active: Energy Burst

Emits a powerful burst of magical damage upon a targeted enemy unit. Upgradable.

Damage: %damage%
Mana Cost: %mana_cost_tooltip%
dagon.lore_loc: A lesser wand that grows in power the longer it is used, it brings magic to the fingertips of the user.
dagon.name: item_dagon
notes_loc: Instantly kills illusions.
Cast Range bonuses from Aether Lens and Dagon do not stack.

dagon_2.desc_loc:
Active: Energy Burst

Emits a powerful burst of magical damage upon a targeted enemy unit. Upgradable.

Damage: %damage%
Mana Cost: %mana_cost_tooltip%
dagon_2.lore_loc: A lesser wand that grows in power the longer it is used, it brings magic to the fingertips of the user.
dagon_2.name: item_dagon_2
notes_loc: Instantly kills illusions.
Cast Range bonuses from Aether Lens and Dagon do not stack.

dagon_3.desc_loc:
Active: Energy Burst

Emits a powerful burst of magical damage upon a targeted enemy unit. Upgradable.

Damage: %damage%
Mana Cost: %mana_cost_tooltip%
dagon_3.lore_loc: A lesser wand that grows in power the longer it is used, it brings magic to the fingertips of the user.
dagon_3.name: item_dagon_3
notes_loc: Instantly kills illusions.
Cast Range bonuses from Aether Lens and Dagon do not stack.

dagon_4.desc_loc:
Active: Energy Burst

Emits a powerful burst of magical damage upon a targeted enemy unit. Upgradable.

Damage: %damage%
Mana Cost: %mana_cost_tooltip%
dagon_4.lore_loc: A lesser wand that grows in power the longer it is used, it brings magic to the fingertips of the user.
dagon_4.name: item_dagon_4
notes_loc: Instantly kills illusions.
Cast Range bonuses from Aether Lens and Dagon do not stack.

dagon_5.desc_loc:
Active: Energy Burst

Emits a powerful burst of magical damage upon a targeted enemy unit.

Damage: %damage%
Mana Cost: %mana_cost_tooltip%
dagon_5.lore_loc: A lesser wand that grows in power the longer it is used, it brings magic to the fingertips of the user.
dagon_5.name: item_dagon_5
notes_loc: Instantly kills illusions.
Cast Range bonuses from Aether Lens and Dagon do not stack.

desolator.desc_loc:
Passive: Corruption

Your attacks reduce the target's armor by %corruption_armor% for %corruption_duration% seconds.

Passive: Soul Stealer

Desolator gains +%bonus_damage_per_kill% damage every time an enemy hero dies while affected by Corruption, to a maximum of %max_damage%.
desolator.lore_loc: A wicked weapon, used in torturing political criminals.
desolator.name: item_desolator
notes_loc: Armor reduction works on buildings.

devastator.desc_loc:
Passive: Witch Blade

Causes your next attack to have true strike, apply a poison for %slow_duration% seconds, slowing by %slow%%% and dealing %int_damage_multiplier%x your intelligence as damage every second.

Passive: Magic Corruption

Your attacks reduce the enemy's Magic resistance by %active_mres_reduction%%% for %passive_cooldown% seconds.
devastator.lore_loc: Warning: There is no antidote if picked up by the wrong end.
devastator.name: item_devastator

diffusal_blade.desc_loc:
Active: Inhibit

Targets an enemy, slowing it for %purge_slow_duration% seconds.

Passive: Manabreak

Each attack burns %feedback_mana_burn% mana from the target, and deals %damage_per_burn% physical damage per burned mana.

Illusions do not burn mana.
diffusal_blade.lore_loc: An enchanted blade that allows the user to cut straight into the enemy's soul.
diffusal_blade.name: item_diffusal_blade
notes_loc: Does not stack with other diffusal blades.

disperser.desc_loc:
Active: Suppress

Dispels both the wearer and the target. Enemy targets are slowed for %enemy_effect_duration% seconds. Allied targets gain bonus movespeed and %slow_resist%%% slow resistance for %ally_effect_duration% seconds. Caster is always granted the ally benefit on cast.

Both movement speed reduction and increase start at %phase_movement_speed%%% and gradually decrease to 0% over the course of the buff duration.
Dispel Type: Basic Dispel

Passive: Manabreak

Each attack burns %feedback_mana_burn% mana from the target, and deals %damage_per_burn% physical damage per burned mana.

Illusions do not burn mana.
disperser.lore_loc: Once entrusted to an Apostle General of the Rumusque Faithful's expeditionary force.
disperser.name: item_disperser

dust.desc_loc:
Use: Reveal

For %duration% seconds, creates an area that reveals and slows invisible heroes by %movespeed%%% in a %radius% radius where the caster was standing. Invisible units revealed by dust take %damage% damage.

The debuff effect on enemies lingers for %linger_duration%s after leaving the area of effect.
dust.lore_loc: One may hide visage, but never volume.
dust.name: item_dust
notes_loc: Places a debuff on enemy units in the area that reveals them when they are invisible.

echo_sabre.desc_loc:
Passive: Echo Strike

Causes melee attacks to attack twice in quick succession. The double attacks apply a %movement_slow%%% movement slow for %slow_duration% seconds on the first strike.
echo_sabre.lore_loc: A deceptively swift blade imbued with resonant magic.
echo_sabre.name: item_echo_sabre

enchanted_mango.lore_loc: The bittersweet flavors of Jidi Isle are irresistible to amphibians.
enchanted_mango.name: item_enchanted_mango
notes_loc: Hold Control to use on a nearby allied hero.

essence_distiller.desc_loc:
Active: Soul Release

Provides %soul_heal_amount% health regeneration when cast on allies.

Can be ground targeted to lie dormant for up to %ground_duration%s and attach to the first enemy that comes within %latch_range% radius. When on enemies, deals %soul_damage_amount% damage per second and provides True Sight over them and shares their vision with the wearer's team.

Lasts %duration% seconds.

Gains charges every time an enemy hero dies within %soul_radius% units.
essence_distiller.name: item_essence_distiller
notes_loc: Empty distillers gain 2 charges.
Only the closest Essence Distiller to the dying hero will gain a charge.
If the allied unit is attacked by an enemy hero or Roshan, the effect is lost.
Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.
While dormant, provides vision in %latch_vision% radius. Vision lingers for %linger_after_latch_duration%s after latching.

ethereal_blade.desc_loc:
Active: Ether Blast

Converts the target unit to ethereal form, rendering them immune to physical damage, but unable to attack and %ethereal_damage_bonus%%% more vulnerable to magic damage.

Enemy targets are also slowed by %blast_movement_slow%%%, and take %blast_stat_multiplier%x the sum of all your attributes + %blast_damage_base% as magical damage.
Duration: %duration% seconds
ethereal_blade.lore_loc: A flickering blade of a ghastly nature, it is capable of dealing damage in both magical and physical planes.
ethereal_blade.name: item_ethereal_blade
notes_loc: Shares cooldown with Ghost Scepter and its upgrades.
Ethereal units take %ethereal_damage_bonus%%% bonus magic damage.

faerie_fire.lore_loc: The ethereal flames from the ever-burning ruins of Kindertree ignite across realities.
faerie_fire.name: item_faerie_fire

falcon_blade.lore_loc: An enchanted blade that long ago raised a hopeless urchin from pauper to king.
falcon_blade.name: item_falcon_blade

flask.desc_loc:
Use: Salve

Grants %health_regen% health regeneration to the target for %buff_duration% seconds.

If the unit is attacked by an enemy hero or Roshan, the effect is lost.

Heals for half the amount per second when cast on an ally.
flask.lore_loc: A magical salve that can quickly mend even the deepest of wounds.
flask.name: item_flask

force_staff.desc_loc:
Active: Force

Pushes any target unit %push_length% units in the direction it is facing.
force_staff.lore_loc: Allows you to manipulate others, for good or evil.
force_staff.name: item_force_staff
notes_loc: Self-cast will cause you to use Force on yourself.
Force Staff doesn't interrupt the target's actions.
Will not work on a unit inside Chronosphere, Duel, or Black Hole.
Force Staff has %enemy_cast_range% cast range when cast on enemies.

gem.desc_loc:
Active: Reveal

Gives True Sight over a %active_radius% radius revealing wards and units even in Fog of War.

Passive: True Sight

Grants the ability to see invisible units and wards to any allied vision within %radius% range of its carrier.

Passive: Everlasting

Dropped on death, and cannot be destroyed.
gem.lore_loc:
Not one thrall creature of the depths,
Nor spirit bound in drowning's keep,
Nor Maelrawn the Tentacular,
Shall rest till seas, gem comes to sleep.
gem.name: item_gem
notes_loc: Disabled while on a courier.

ghost.desc_loc:
Active: Ghost Form

You enter ghost form for %duration% seconds, becoming immune to physical damage, but are unable to attack and %extra_spell_damage_percent%%% more vulnerable to magic damage.
ghost.lore_loc: Imbues the wielder with a ghostly presence, allowing them to evade physical damage.
ghost.name: item_ghost
notes_loc: Ends if you become Debuff Immune, and will have no effect if you are already Debuff Immune.
Shares cooldown with all Ghost Scepter upgrades.

glimmer_cape.desc_loc:
Active: Glimmer

After a %initial_fade_delay% second delay, grants invisibility, %active_movement_speed% movement speed and a magic damage barrier that absorbs up to %barrier_block% damage to you or a target allied unit for %duration% seconds.

Can be cast while channeling.
glimmer_cape.lore_loc: The stolen cape of a master illusionist.
glimmer_cape.name: item_glimmer_cape

greater_crit.desc_loc:
Passive: Critical Strike

Grants each attack a %crit_chance%%% chance to deal %crit_multiplier%%% damage.
greater_crit.lore_loc: A weapon of incredible power that is difficult for even the strongest of warriors to control.
greater_crit.name: item_greater_crit
notes_loc: Critical Strike does not work against buildings.

grisgris.desc_loc: This item that cannot be dropped or placed in the backpack but can be put into normal inventory slots. When the owner dies, %death_gold_lost_reduction_pct%%% of the gold lost from death is added to the item, and will be refunded when the item is consumed. Right-click to consume and permanently remove the item.
grisgris.name: item_grisgris

guardian_greaves.desc_loc:
Active: Mend

Restores %replenish_health% health and %replenish_mana% mana to nearby allies, and removes most negative effects from the caster.

Radius: %replenish_radius%
Dispel Type: Basic Dispel

Passive: Guardian Aura

Grants %aura_health_regen% health regeneration and %aura_mana_regen% mana regeneration to allied units. If the wearer's health falls below %aura_bonus_threshold%%%, their health regeneration is increased to %aura_health_regen_bonus%.

Radius: %aura_radius% Movement speed bonuses from multiple pairs of boots do not stack.
guardian_greaves.lore_loc: One of many holy instruments constructed to honor the Omniscience.
guardian_greaves.name: item_guardian_greaves
notes_loc: Mend does not affect units that have been affected by Mend or Mekansm Restore within Guardian Greaves' cooldown.

gungir.desc_loc:
Active: Eternal Chains

Roots all enemies in a %radius_tooltip% radius for %duration% seconds.
gungir.lore_loc: Bindings forged by impossible means to leash an ancient evil.
gungir.name: item_gungir
notes_loc: AoE bonuses from multiple Chasm Stones or its upgrades do not stack.

hand_of_midas.desc_loc:
Active: Transmute

Kills a non-hero target for %bonus_gold% gold. Killing a neutral creep additionally grants a madstone bundle.

Cannot be used on Ancient creeps.
hand_of_midas.lore_loc: Preserved through unknown magical means, the Hand of Midas is a weapon of greed, sacrificing animals to line the owner's pockets.
hand_of_midas.name: item_hand_of_midas
notes_loc: The gold given is unreliable gold (you do not get the normal creep bounty).
Experience gained by using Transmute is not shared.

harpoon.desc_loc:
Active: Draw Forth

When targeting an enemy, fire a harpoon at them, that pulls you and the target closer together, up to %pull_distance_pct%%% of the distance between you and your target. If the caster is melee, the hero and target are always pulled to within melee distance of each other. Targeting a tree always pulls you all the way to that tree.

Passive: Echo Strike

Causes melee attacks to attack twice in quick succession. The double attacks apply a %movement_slow%%% movement slow for %slow_duration% seconds on the first strike. Echo Strike cooldown: %passive_cooldown%s
harpoon.lore_loc: A perfect solution for the flight of foes.
harpoon.name: item_harpoon

headdress.desc_loc:
Passive: Regeneration Aura

Grants %aura_health_regen% health regeneration to allies.

Radius: %aura_radius%
headdress.lore_loc: Creates a soothing aura that restores allies in battle.
headdress.name: item_headdress

heart.desc_loc:
Passive: Behemoth's Blood

Your health regeneration is increased by %missing_health_regen%%% of your missing health.
heart.lore_loc: Preserved heart of an extinct monster, it bolsters the bearer's fortitude.
heart.name: item_heart
notes_loc: Multiple instances of Behemoth's Blood do not stack.

heavens_halberd.desc_loc:
Active: Disarm

Prevents a target from attacking for %disarm_melee% seconds.
heavens_halberd.lore_loc: This halberd moves with the speed of a smaller weapon, allowing the bearer to win duels that a heavy edge would not.
heavens_halberd.name: item_heavens_halberd

helm_of_iron_will.lore_loc: The helmet of a legendary warrior who fell in battle.
helm_of_iron_will.name: item_helm_of_iron_will

helm_of_the_dominator.desc_loc:
Active: Dominate

Takes control of one neutral, non-ancient target unit and sets its movement speed to %speed_base% and max health to a minimum of %health_min%. Also provides the unit with +%creep_bonus_damage% base attack damage, +%creep_bonus_hp_regen% health regen, +%creep_bonus_mp_regen% mana regen and +%creep_bonus_armor% armor.

Dominated units with a max health of greater than %health_min% retain their original max health. Grants the caster %bounty_pct%%% of the gold and experience bounty of the dominated creep. Dominated unit's bounty is set to %bounty_gold% gold and it can no longer be killed by abilities that instantly kill creeps otherwise.

The Helm cannot be used for %creep_damage_taken_cooldown% seconds after the dominated creep takes damage from an enemy hero or Roshan.
helm_of_the_dominator.lore_loc: The powerful headpiece of a dead necromancer.
helm_of_the_dominator.name: item_helm_of_the_dominator
notes_loc: Cannot dominate more than one unit at a time.  If a new unit is dominated, the old one will die.
Can also Dominate enemy lane creeps and summoned units.
Selling Helm of the Dominator will cause dominated units to die.

helm_of_the_overlord.desc_loc:
Active: Dominate

Takes control of one neutral target unit and sets its movement speed to %speed_base% and max health to a minimum of %health_min%. Also provides the unit with +%creep_bonus_damage% base attack damage, +%creep_bonus_hp_regen% health regen, +%creep_bonus_mp_regen% mana regen, +%creep_bonus_armor% armor, and levels up some abilities of the target by 1 level.

Dominated units with a max health of greater than %health_min% retain their original max health. Grants the caster the gold and experience bounty of the dominated creep. Dominated unit's bounty is set to %bounty_gold% gold and it can no longer be killed by abilities that instantly kill creeps otherwise.

The Helm cannot be used for %creep_damage_taken_cooldown% seconds after the dominated creep takes damage from an enemy hero or Roshan.
helm_of_the_overlord.lore_loc: The powerful headpiece of an undead necromancer.
helm_of_the_overlord.name: item_helm_of_the_overlord
notes_loc: Can also Dominate enemy lane creeps and summoned units.
Selling will cause dominated units to die.

holy_locket.desc_loc:
Active: Energy Charge

Target an allied unit to increase their incoming Heal Amplification by %incoming_heal_increase_active%%% for %active_buff_duration%s and instantly restore %health_restore_per_charge% health and %mana_restore_per_charge% mana per charge stored.

Automatically gains a charge every %AbilityChargeRestoreTime% seconds and whenever a visible enemy within %charge_radius% range uses an ability.

Passive: Holy Blessing

Amplifies heals you provide by %heal_increase_passive%%%.
holy_locket.lore_loc: A prized relic long thought lost forever in a failed crusade.
holy_locket.name: item_holy_locket

hurricane_pike.desc_loc:
Active: Hurricane Thrust

Pushes you and target enemy %enemy_length% units away from each other, and for %range_duration% seconds, allows you to make %max_attacks% attacks against the target without range restrictions and with +%bonus_attack_speed% attack speed.

Can be cast on self or allies to push the target %push_length% units in the direction it is facing.
Enemy Range: %cast_range_enemy%
hurricane_pike.lore_loc: A legendary pike once held as royal sigil of the ancient wyvern riders.
hurricane_pike.name: item_hurricane_pike
notes_loc: Self-cast will use Hurricane Pike on yourself.
Hurricane Pike doesn't interrupt the target's actions.
Will not work on a unit inside Chronosphere, Duel, or Black Hole.
Attack Range bonuses from Monkey King Bar and Dragon Lance and its upgrades do not stack.

hydras_breath.desc_loc:
Passive: Miasma

Attacks poison enemies, dealing %poison_damage_per_second%%% of the target's Max HP as Magical Damage per second for %poison_duration% seconds.

Passive: Polycephaly

Ranged attacks have a %proc_chance%%% chance to fire additional projectiles at up to %count% nearby enemies with %secondary_target_range_bonus% extra range and within a %secondary_target_angle% degree angle in front of the attacker. The additional projectiles deal %base_proc_dmg% + %proc_dmg_pct%%% damage of a normal attack and do not trigger on hit effects except for Miasma. The primary attack deals %base_proc_dmg% + %proc_dmg_pct_primary_tooltip%%% damage of a normal attack.
hydras_breath.name: item_hydras_breath
notes_loc: Attack Range bonuses from Monkey King Bar and Dragon Lance and its upgrades do not stack.

infused_raindrop.desc_loc:
Passive: Magical Damage Block

Consumes a charge to block %magic_damage_block% magic damage from damage instances over %min_damage% damage.

Comes with %initial_charges% charges. When the charges are gone, the item disappears.
infused_raindrop.name: item_infused_raindrop
notes_loc: Uses at most one charge per damage instance.

invis_sword.desc_loc:
Active: Shadow Walk

Makes you invisible for %windwalk_duration% seconds, or until you attack or cast a spell. While Shadow Walk is active, you move %windwalk_movement_speed%%% faster and can move through units.

If attacking to end the invisibility, you gain %windwalk_bonus_damage% bonus physical damage on that attack.
invis_sword.lore_loc: The blade of a fallen king, it allows you to move unseen and strike from the shadows.
invis_sword.name: item_invis_sword
notes_loc: Has a %windwalk_fade_time% second fade time.
If the invisibility ends without attacking, the bonus damage is lost.

javelin.desc_loc:
Passive: Pierce

Grants each attack a %bonus_chance%%% chance to pierce through evasion and deal %bonus_chance_damage% bonus magical damage.
javelin.lore_loc: A rather typical spear that can sometimes pierce through an enemy's armor when used to attack.
javelin.name: item_javelin

kaya.lore_loc: The staff of a renowned sorceress, lost for countless millennia.
kaya.name: item_kaya
notes_loc: Multiple instances of this item do not stack.

kaya_and_sange.lore_loc: Two of three known items of unimaginable power that many believe were crafted at the same enchanter's forge.
kaya_and_sange.name: item_kaya_and_sange

lesser_crit.desc_loc:
Passive: Critical Strike

Grants each attack a %crit_chance%%% chance to deal %crit_multiplier%%% damage.
lesser_crit.lore_loc: A blade forged from rare crystals, it seeks weak points in enemy armor.
lesser_crit.name: item_lesser_crit
notes_loc: Critical Strike does not work against buildings.

lifesteal.desc_loc:
Passive: Lifesteal

Heals the attacker for a percentage of physical damage dealt.
lifesteal.lore_loc: A mask that drains the energy of those caught in its gaze.
lifesteal.name: item_lifesteal

lotus_orb.desc_loc:
Active: Echo Shell

Applies a shield to the target unit for %active_duration% seconds which re-casts most targeted spells back to their caster.

The shielded unit will still take damage from the spell.
Dispel Type: Basic Dispel
lotus_orb.lore_loc: The jewel at its center still reflects a pale image of its creator.
lotus_orb.name: item_lotus_orb
notes_loc: Targeted abilities from neutral items do not trigger Echo Shell.

maelstrom.desc_loc:
Passive: Chain Lightning

Grants a %chain_chance%%% chance on attack to release a bolt of electricity that leaps between %chain_strikes% targets within a %chain_radius% radius, dealing %chain_damage% magical damage to each. Lightning proc pierces evasion.
maelstrom.lore_loc: A hammer forged for the gods themselves, Maelstrom allows its user to harness the power of lightning.
maelstrom.name: item_maelstrom

mage_slayer.desc_loc:
Passive: Mage Slayer

Places a debuff when you attack enemies, dealing %dps% physical damage per second and causing them to do %spell_amp_debuff%%% less spell damage for %duration% seconds.
mage_slayer.lore_loc: Forged by a secret order in The Third Age of Praxa'cia to fell the False King.
mage_slayer.name: item_mage_slayer

magic_stick.desc_loc:
Active: Energy Charge

Instantly restores %restore_per_charge% health and mana per charge stored.

Max %max_charges% charges. Gains a charge whenever a visible enemy within %charge_radius% range uses an ability.
magic_stick.lore_loc: A simple wand used to channel magic energies, it is favored by apprentice wizards and great warlocks alike.
magic_stick.name: item_magic_stick
notes_loc: Gains charges for spells cast by visible enemies in 1200 range.
Certain abilities and item abilities will not add charges.

magic_wand.desc_loc:
Active: Energy Charge

Instantly restores %restore_per_charge% health and mana per charge stored.

Max %max_charges% charges. Gains a charge whenever a visible enemy within %charge_radius% range uses an ability.
magic_wand.lore_loc: A simple wand used to channel magic energies, it is favored by apprentice wizards and great warlocks alike.
magic_wand.name: item_magic_wand
notes_loc: Gains charges for spells cast by visible enemies in 1200 range.
Certain abilities and item abilities will not add charges.

manta.desc_loc:
Active: Mirror Image

Creates %images_count% images of your hero that last %illusion_duration% seconds.

Melee images deal %tooltip_damage_outgoing_melee%%% damage, while Ranged images deal %tooltip_damage_outgoing_ranged%%%. Illusions take %tooltip_damage_incoming_total_pct%%% damage.

Dispel Type: Basic Dispel
manta.lore_loc: An axe made of reflective materials that causes confusion amongst enemy ranks.
manta.name: item_manta
notes_loc: Has a %invuln_duration% second cast time during which you are invulnerable.
Many effects are removed upon using Manta.
Yasha based movement speed bonuses from multiple items do not stack.

mask_of_madness.desc_loc:
Active: Berserk

Gives %berserk_bonus_attack_speed% attack speed, %berserk_bonus_movement_speed%%% / %berserk_bonus_movement_speed_melee%%% movement speed (ranged/melee), and %berserk_slow_resist%%%/%berserk_slow_resist_melee%%% slow resistance (ranged/melee), but reduces your armor by %berserk_armor_reduction% and silences you. Lasts %berserk_duration% seconds.

Passive: Lifesteal

Heals the attacker for a percentage of physical damage dealt.
mask_of_madness.lore_loc: Once this mask is worn, its bearer becomes an uncontrollable aggressive force.
mask_of_madness.name: item_mask_of_madness

mekansm.desc_loc:
Active: Restore

Restores %heal_amount% health to allied units in a %heal_radius% radius.

Passive: Mekansm Aura

Grants %aura_health_regen% health regeneration to allied units in a %aura_radius% radius.
mekansm.lore_loc: A glowing jewel formed out of assorted parts that somehow fit together perfectly.
mekansm.name: item_mekansm
notes_loc: Restore does not affect units that have been affected by Restore or Guardian Greaves Mend within Mekansm's cooldown.
Multiple instances of Mekansm Aura do not stack.

meteor_hammer.desc_loc:
Active: Meteor Hammer

CHANNELED - After a successful channel, summons a meteor that strikes a %impact_radius% AoE, stunning enemies for %stun_duration% seconds and dealing impact damage. Continues to deal damage over time to enemies units and buildings for %burn_duration% seconds. Non-building units are also slowed for %burn_slow%%% for the duration of the burn.

Building Impact Damage: %impact_damage_buildings%
Building Over Time Damage: %burn_dps_buildings%

Non-Building Impact Damage: %impact_damage_units%
Non-Building Over Time Damage: %burn_dps_units%

Channel Duration: %max_duration% seconds.
Landing Time: %land_time% seconds.
meteor_hammer.lore_loc: An enchanted hammer forged of metals discovered in the ruins of a village destroyed by a great star storm.
meteor_hammer.name: item_meteor_hammer

mjollnir.desc_loc:
Active: Static Charge

Places a charged shield on a target unit for %static_duration% seconds which has a %static_chance%%% chance to release a %static_damage% magical damage shocking bolt at a nearby attacker and %static_strikes% additional enemies.

Passive: Chain Lightning

Grants a %chain_chance%%% chance on attack to release a bolt of electricity that leaps between %chain_strikes% targets within a %chain_radius% radius, dealing %chain_damage% magical damage to each. Lightning proc pierces evasion.
mjollnir.lore_loc: Thor's magical hammer, made for him by the dwarves Brok and Eitri.
mjollnir.name: item_mjollnir
notes_loc: Static Charge cannot trigger more than once per second.
Static Charge's shock deals magical damage centered on hero with the Static Charge. Static Charge's targets cannot be more than %static_seconary_radius% range away.
Static Charge procs will not bounce to heroes that are invisible or hidden by Fog of War.

monkey_king_bar.desc_loc:
Passive: Pierce

Grants each attack a %bonus_chance%%% chance to pierce through evasion and deal %bonus_chance_damage% bonus magical damage.
monkey_king_bar.lore_loc: A powerful staff used by a master warrior.
monkey_king_bar.name: item_monkey_king_bar

moon_shard.desc_loc:
Use: Consume

Consume the Moon Shard to permanently gain %consumed_bonus% attack speed and %consumed_bonus_night_vision% bonus night vision. Max 1 use.

Passive: Shade Sight

Grants bonus night vision.
moon_shard.lore_loc: Said to be a tear from the lunar goddess Selemene.
moon_shard.name: item_moon_shard

null_talisman.lore_loc: A small gemstone attached to several chains.
null_talisman.name: item_null_talisman

nullifier.desc_loc:
Active: Nullify

Dispels the target and applies a debuff for %mute_duration% seconds. Continuously dispels and slows the target.

Dispel Type: Basic Dispel
nullifier.lore_loc: A dangerous weapon pilfered from an inverse dimension.
nullifier.name: item_nullifier
notes_loc: Can be cast on invulnerable units.

oblivion_staff.lore_loc: Deceptively hidden as an ordinary staff, it is actually very powerful, much like the Eldritch who originally possessed it.
oblivion_staff.name: item_oblivion_staff

octarine_core.lore_loc: At the core of spellcraft are spectrums only the very gifted can sense.
octarine_core.name: item_octarine_core

orb_of_corrosion.desc_loc:
Passive: Corrosion

Your attacks reduce the target's armor by %corruption_armor%, slows their movement by %slow_ranged%%% (%slow_melee%%% against melee targets), and reduces Health Restoration by %heal_reduction%%%. Lasts for %duration% seconds.
orb_of_corrosion.lore_loc: Seepage from the wounds of a warrior deity, sealed in an arcanist's orb following a campaign of vicious slaughter.
orb_of_corrosion.name: item_orb_of_corrosion
notes_loc: Armor reduction does not stack with its components, Desolator, or Stygian Desolator.

orb_of_frost.desc_loc:
Passive: Frost

Your attacks slow the target's movement by %slow_ranged%%% (%slow_melee%%% against melee targets), and reduces Health Restoration by %heal_reduction%%%. Lasts for %duration% seconds.
orb_of_frost.lore_loc: Slowly growing since the universe began, it will envelop everything when it ends.
orb_of_frost.name: item_orb_of_frost

orb_of_venom.desc_loc:
Passive: Poison Attack

Poisons the target, dealing %damage% magical damage per second. Lasts for %poison_duration% seconds.
orb_of_venom.lore_loc: Envenoms your veapon with the venom of a venomous viper.
orb_of_venom.name: item_orb_of_venom
notes_loc: Does not stack with its upgrades.

orchid.desc_loc:
Active: Soul Burn

Silences the target unit for %silence_duration% seconds. At the end of the silence, %silence_damage_percent%%% of the damage received while silenced is inflicted as bonus magical damage.
orchid.lore_loc: A garnet rod constructed from the essence of a fire demon.
orchid.name: item_orchid

overwhelming_blink.desc_loc:
Active: Overwhelming Blink

Teleport to a target point up to %blink_range% units away.

After teleportation, all enemies in a %radius% AoE take damage equal to %damage_base% + %damage_pct_instant%%% of your strength and an additional %damage_pct_over_time%%% over time, and have %movement_slow%%% movement speed slow and %attack_slow% attack speed slow for %duration% seconds.

Overwhelming Blink cannot be used for %blink_damage_cooldown% seconds after taking damage from an enemy hero or Roshan.
overwhelming_blink.lore_loc: A horrifying dagger forged in the chaos maw and nigh untouchable by mortal hands.
overwhelming_blink.name: item_overwhelming_blink
notes_loc: Self-casting will cause you to teleport in the direction of your team's fountain.

pavise.desc_loc:
Active: Protect

When cast on an ally, grants them a physical damage barrier that absorbs %absorb_amount% damage. Duration: %duration%s.
pavise.lore_loc: Devised by a wizard who made one too many enemies.
pavise.name: item_pavise

pers.lore_loc: A gem that grants heart to the bearer.
pers.name: item_pers

phase_boots.desc_loc:
Active: Phase

Gives %phase_movement_speed%%% increased movement speed on melee heroes, and %phase_movement_speed_range%%% on ranged heroes, and lets you move through units and turn more quickly for %phase_duration% seconds. Movement speed bonuses from multiple pairs of boots do not stack.
phase_boots.lore_loc: Boots that allow the wearer to travel between the ether.
phase_boots.name: item_phase_boots

phylactery.desc_loc:
Passive: Empower Spell

The next Unit Target spell you cast on an enemy deals a separate %bonus_spell_damage% bonus damage to the target and slows them by %slow%%% for %slow_duration%s.
phylactery.lore_loc: An amulet overflowing with powerful magics.
phylactery.name: item_phylactery

pipe.desc_loc:
Active: Barrier

Gives a magic damage barrier that absorbs %barrier_block% damage to all nearby allies. Lasts %barrier_duration% seconds.

Radius: %barrier_radius%

Passive: Insight Aura

Gives allied units %magic_resistance_aura%%% magic resistance.

Radius: %aura_radius%
pipe.lore_loc: A powerful artifact of mysterious origin, it creates barriers against magical forces.
pipe.name: item_pipe
notes_loc: Barrier does not affect units that have been affected by Barrier within Pipe of Insight's cooldown.
Stacks multiplicatively with other sources of magic resistance.

quelling_blade.desc_loc:
Active: Chop Tree

Destroy a target tree.

Passive: Quell

Increases attack damage against non-hero units by %damage_bonus% for melee heroes, and %damage_bonus_ranged% for ranged.
quelling_blade.lore_loc: The axe of a fallen gnome, it allows you to effectively maneuver the forest.
quelling_blade.name: item_quelling_blade
notes_loc: Effects of multiple quelling blades do not stack.

radiance.desc_loc:
Toggle: Burn

When active, scorches enemies for %aura_damage% magical damage per second. Illusions deal %aura_damage_illusions% magical damage per second.

Radius: %aura_radius%
radiance.lore_loc: A divine weapon that causes damage and a bright burning effect that lays waste to nearby enemies.
radiance.name: item_radiance

rapier.desc_loc:
Toggle: Transmute

Toggle to gain either %bonus_spell_amp%%% bonus spell amplification or %bonus_damage% bonus attack damage.

Passive: Everlasting

Dropped on death, and cannot be destroyed.

Becomes unusable if picked up by an ally of its owner until it is returned to its owner. It is immediately usable by anybody if an enemy of the owner picks it up and is killed. A dropped Rapier cannot be picked up by a courier.
rapier.lore_loc: So powerful, it cannot have a single owner.
rapier.name: item_rapier
notes_loc: If Divine Rapier is dropped and picked up by an enemy of its original owner, it cannot be dropped again except by death.
Spell Amplification from multiple Rapiers does not stack.

refresher.desc_loc:
Active: Reset Cooldowns

Resets the cooldowns of all your abilities. Shares a cooldown with Refresher Shard. This item's cooldown only progresses in your hero's main inventory.
refresher.lore_loc: A powerful artifact created for wizards.
refresher.name: item_refresher
refresher.shard_loc:
Use: Reset Cooldowns

Resets the cooldowns of all your abilities. Shares a cooldown with Refresher Orb. This item's cooldown only progresses in your hero's main inventory.

refresher_shard.desc_loc:
Use: Reset Cooldowns

Resets the cooldowns of all your abilities. Shares a cooldown with Refresher Orb. This item's cooldown only progresses in your hero's main inventory.
refresher_shard.lore_loc: Across an epoch of endless battle, the Immortal's will to triumph never faltered.
refresher_shard.name: item_refresher_shard
notes_loc: Refresher Shard is shareable.

revenants_brooch.desc_loc:
Passive: Phantom Critical

Grants each attack a %crit_chance%%% chance to deal an additional %crit_multiplier%%% of the attack's damage as bonus magic damage.
revenants_brooch.lore_loc: The cursed brooch of a fallen guardian who stalks forever between the veil of life and death.
revenants_brooch.name: item_revenants_brooch
notes_loc: Counts as a Critical Strike for purposes of stacking with other sources of Critical Strike.
Phantom Critical does not work against buildings.

ring_of_basilius.desc_loc:
Passive: Basilius Aura

Grants %aura_mana_regen% mana regeneration to allies.

Radius: %aura_radius%
ring_of_basilius.lore_loc: Ring given as a reward to the greatest mages.
ring_of_basilius.name: item_ring_of_basilius

ring_of_health.lore_loc: A shiny ring found beneath a fat halfling's corpse.
ring_of_health.name: item_ring_of_health

ring_of_regen.lore_loc: This ring is considered a good luck charm among the Gnomes.
ring_of_regen.name: item_ring_of_regen

ring_of_tarrasque.lore_loc: An ageless ring forged with an otherwise simple blood magic amplified by the presumed source of its key component.
ring_of_tarrasque.name: item_ring_of_tarrasque

rod_of_atos.lore_loc: Atos, the Lord of Blight, has his essence stored in this deceptively simple wand.
rod_of_atos.name: item_rod_of_atos

sange.lore_loc: Sange is an unusually accurate weapon, seeking weak points automatically.
sange.name: item_sange

sange_and_yasha.lore_loc: Sange and Yasha, when attuned by the moonlight and used together, become a very powerful combination.
sange_and_yasha.name: item_sange_and_yasha
notes_loc: Yasha-based movement speed bonuses from multiple items do not stack.

satanic.desc_loc:
Active: Unholy Rage

Increases Lifesteal percentage to %unholy_lifesteal_total_tooltip%%% for %unholy_duration% seconds.

Dispel Type: Basic Dispel

Passive: Lifesteal

Heals the attacker for a percentage of physical damage dealt.
satanic.lore_loc: Immense power at the cost of your soul.
satanic.name: item_satanic

shadow_amulet.desc_loc:
Active: Fade

Grants invisibility to you or a target allied hero for %fade_duration%s. Movement speed during the invisibility is reduced by %movement_speed_reduction%%%.
shadow_amulet.lore_loc: A small talisman that clouds the senses of one's enemies when held perfectly still.
shadow_amulet.name: item_shadow_amulet
notes_loc: Takes %fade_time%s of the %fade_duration%s for the hero to fully fade into invisibility.

sheepstick.desc_loc:
Active: Hex

Turns a target unit into a harmless critter for %sheep_duration% seconds. The target has a base movement speed of %sheep_movement_speed% and will be silenced, muted, and disarmed.
Instantly destroys illusions.
sheepstick.lore_loc: The most guarded relic among the cult of Vyse, it is the most coveted weapon among magi.
sheepstick.name: item_sheepstick
notes_loc: The target will have a base movement speed of %sheep_movement_speed%, but buffs granting maximum movement speed won't be disabled.

shivas_guard.desc_loc:
Active: Arctic Blast

Emits a freezing wave that deals %blast_damage% magical damage to enemies and slows their movement by %blast_movement_speed%%% for %blast_debuff_duration% seconds.

Radius: %blast_radius%

Passive: Freezing Aura

Reduces the attack speed of all enemies by %aura_attack_speed%.

Radius: %aura_radius%
shivas_guard.lore_loc: Said to have belonged to a goddess, today it retains much of its former power.
shivas_guard.name: item_shivas_guard
notes_loc: The wave extends at a speed of %blast_speed% to a max size of %blast_radius%.
The Arctic Blast follows its caster.
Multiple instances of Freezing Aura do not stack.
AoE bonuses from multiple Chasm Stones or its upgrades do not stack.

silver_edge.desc_loc:
Active: Shadow Walk

Makes you invisible for %windwalk_duration% seconds, or until you attack or cast a spell. While invisible, you move %windwalk_movement_speed%%% faster and can move through units.

Attacking to end the invisibility will deal %windwalk_bonus_damage% bonus physical damage, disable their passive abilities for %backstab_duration% seconds, and cap their movement speed to %max_movement_speed%.
silver_edge.lore_loc: Once used to slay an unjust king, only to have the kingdom erupt into civil war in the aftermath.
silver_edge.name: item_silver_edge

skadi.desc_loc:
Passive: Cold Attack

Attacks lower enemy movement by %cold_slow_melee%%% if they are melee and %cold_slow_ranged%%% if they are ranged. Attacks also lower enemy attack speed by %cold_attack_slow_melee%%% and Health Restoration by %restoration_reduction%%%. Lasts for %cold_duration% seconds.
skadi.lore_loc: Extremely rare artifact, guarded by the azure dragons.
skadi.name: item_skadi

smoke_of_deceit.desc_loc:
Use: Disguise

Turns the caster and all allied player-controlled targets in a %application_radius% radius invisible, and grants %bonus_movement_speed%%% bonus movement speed for %duration% seconds.

While the caster is still disguised, any allies that come within %secondary_application_radius% range of them will also get the buff applied to them. Each smoke can only be applied once to allies.

Attacking or moving within %visibility_radius% range of an enemy hero or tower, will break the invisibility.

Disguise grants invisibility that is immune to True Sight.

Smoke of Deceit is usable from the backpack and has no cooldown when swapped into the main inventory.
smoke_of_deceit.lore_loc: The charlatan wizard Myrddin's only true contribution to the arcane arts.
smoke_of_deceit.name: item_smoke_of_deceit

sobi_mask.lore_loc: A mask commonly used by mages and warlocks for various rituals.
sobi_mask.name: item_sobi_mask

solar_crest.desc_loc:
Active: Shine

When cast on an ally, grants them %target_armor% armor, %target_attack_speed% attack speed, %target_movement_speed%%% movement speed and a %absorb_amount% physical damage barrier.

Does not grant bonus armor, movement or attack speed if used on self.

Duration: %duration%
solar_crest.lore_loc: A talisman forged to honor the daytime sky.
solar_crest.name: item_solar_crest
notes_loc: Shares cooldown with Pavise.

soul_ring.desc_loc:
Active: Sacrifice

Consume %AbilityHealthCost% health to temporarily gain %mana_gain% mana. Lasts %duration% seconds.

If the mana gained cannot fit in your mana pool, it creates a buffer of mana that will be used before your mana pool.
soul_ring.lore_loc: A ring that feeds on the souls of those who wear it.
soul_ring.name: item_soul_ring
notes_loc: If this mana is not used before the duration ends, the extra mana is lost.

specialists_array.desc_loc:
Passive: Splitshot

Ranged attacks have a %proc_chance%%% chance to fire additional projectiles at up to %count% nearby enemies with %secondary_target_range_bonus% extra range and within a %secondary_target_angle% degree angle in front of the attacker. The additional projectiles deal %base_proc_dmg% + %proc_dmg_pct%%% damage of a normal attack and do not trigger on hit effects. The primary attack deals %base_proc_dmg% + %proc_dmg_pct_primary_tooltip%%% damage of a normal attack.
specialists_array.lore_loc: An impressive kit of trigger enhancements born in an aging assassin's idle mind.
specialists_array.name: item_specialists_array

sphere.desc_loc:
Passive: Spellblock

Blocks most targeted spells once every %block_cooldown% seconds.

Active: Transfer Spellblock

Temporarily removes Spellblock from the item's owner and transfers it to an allied unit for %block_cooldown% seconds.
sphere.lore_loc: This magical sphere once protected one of the most famous heroes in history.
sphere.name: item_sphere
notes_loc: Targeted abilities from neutral items do not trigger Spellblock.

spirit_vessel.desc_loc:
Active: Soul Release

When used against enemies, it reduces health by %enemy_hp_drain%%% of current health per second, and reduces Health Restoration by %restoration_reduction_enemy%%%. Deals %soul_damage_amount% damage per second.

When used on allies, it provides %soul_heal_amount% health regeneration per second.

Lasts %duration% seconds.

Gains charges every time an enemy hero dies within %soul_radius% units or the user dies.
spirit_vessel.lore_loc: Forged by a god to entrap the soul of another.
spirit_vessel.name: item_spirit_vessel
notes_loc: Empty vessels gain 2 charges.
Only the closest Spirit Vessel to the dying hero will gain a charge.
If the allied unit is attacked by an enemy hero or Roshan, the effect is lost.
Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.

swift_blink.desc_loc:
Active: Swift Blink

Teleport to a target point up to %blink_range% units away.

After teleportation, you gain %bonus_movement%%% phased movement speed and +%bonus_agi_active% Agility for %duration% seconds.

Swift Blink cannot be used for %blink_damage_cooldown% seconds after taking damage from an enemy hero or Roshan.
swift_blink.lore_loc: A cunning blade able to anticipate and enable its bearer's movements.
swift_blink.name: item_swift_blink
notes_loc: Self-casting will cause you to teleport in the direction of your team's fountain.

talisman_of_evasion.lore_loc: A necklace that allows you to anticipate enemy attacks.
talisman_of_evasion.name: item_talisman_of_evasion
notes_loc: Stacks diminishingly with other sources of Evasion.

tango.desc_loc:
Use: Devour

Consumes a target tree to gain %health_regen% health regeneration for %buff_duration% seconds. Consuming an Ironwood Tree doubles the heal duration.

Comes with %tooltip_charges% charges. Can be used on an allied hero to give them one Tango.

Tree Range: %abilitycastrange%
tango.lore_loc: Forage to survive on the battlefield.
tango.name: item_tango

tango_single.desc_loc:
Use: Devour

Consumes a target tree to gain %health_regen% health regeneration for %buff_duration% seconds. Consuming an Ironwood Tree doubles the heal duration.

Tree Range: %abilitycastrange%
tango_single.name: item_tango_single

tiara_of_selemene.lore_loc: A symbol of favor bestowed upon the high priestess of Selemene.
tiara_of_selemene.name: item_tiara_of_selemene

tpscroll.desc_loc:
Use: Teleport

After channeling for %tooltip_channel_time% seconds, teleports you to a target friendly building.

Double-click to teleport to your team's base fountain.
tpscroll.name: item_tpscroll
notes_loc: If multiple heroes teleport to the same location in succession, the channeling time will be increased for each successive hero.
Teleport can be prevented or canceled by Root abilities.

tranquil_boots.desc_loc:
Passive: Break

Whenever you attack a hero or are attacked by any unit, the bonus %bonus_health_regen% HP regen is lost and the movement speed bonus is reduced to %broken_movement_speed% for %break_time% seconds. Movement speed bonuses from multiple pairs of boots do not stack.
tranquil_boots.lore_loc: While they increase the longevity of the wearer, this boot is not particularly reliable.
tranquil_boots.name: item_tranquil_boots

travel_boots.desc_loc:
Upgrade: Town Portal Scroll

Upgrades your Town Portal Scroll, allowing it to target units, reduces cooldown and does not consume a charge on usage. Movement speed bonuses from multiple pairs of boots do not stack.
travel_boots.name: item_travel_boots

travel_boots_2.desc_loc:
Upgrade: Town Portal Scroll

Upgrades your Town Portal Scroll, allowing it to target units and heroes, reduces cooldown, channel time and does not consume a charge on usage. Movement speed bonuses from multiple pairs of boots do not stack.
travel_boots_2.name: item_travel_boots_2

urn_of_shadows.desc_loc:
Active: Soul Release

Provides %soul_heal_amount% health regeneration when cast on allies, and deals %soul_damage_amount% damage per second when cast on enemies.

Lasts %duration% seconds.

Gains charges every time an enemy hero dies within %soul_radius% units.
urn_of_shadows.lore_loc: Contains the ashes of powerful demons.
urn_of_shadows.name: item_urn_of_shadows
notes_loc: Empty urns gain 2 charges.
If the allied unit is attacked by an enemy hero or Roshan, the effect is lost.
Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.

vanguard.desc_loc:
Passive: Damage Block

Grants a %block_chance%%% chance to block %block_damage_melee% damage from incoming attacks on melee heroes, and %block_damage_ranged% damage on ranged.
vanguard.lore_loc: A powerful shield that defends its wielder from even the most vicious of attacks.
vanguard.name: item_vanguard
notes_loc: Multiple sources of damage block do not stack.

veil_of_discord.desc_loc:
Active: Spell Weakness

Cast a %debuff_radius% radius blast that causes enemy heroes to take %spell_amp%%% increased damage from spells.

Can be cast while channeling.

Duration: %resist_debuff_duration% seconds.
veil_of_discord.name: item_veil_of_discord
notes_loc: Spell Weakness does not stack with Bloodstone's Spell Weakness Aura.

vladmir.desc_loc:
Passive: Vladmir's Aura

Grants %lifesteal_aura%%% lifesteal, %damage_aura%%% bonus damage, %mana_regen_aura% mana regeneration, and %armor_aura% armor to nearby allies.

Radius: %aura_radius%
vladmir.lore_loc: An eerie mask that is haunted with the malice of a fallen vampire.
vladmir.name: item_vladmir
notes_loc: Lifesteal on attacks against creeps is reduced to %lifesteal_creeps_tooltip%%%.

void_stone.lore_loc: Jewelry that was once used to channel nether realm magic, this ring pulses with energy.
void_stone.name: item_void_stone

voodoo_mask.desc_loc:
Passive: Spell Lifesteal

Heals the wearer for a percentage of spell damage dealt to enemies.
voodoo_mask.lore_loc: A mask tuned to sip the arcane bindings that pass between caster and foe.
voodoo_mask.name: item_voodoo_mask
notes_loc: Does not heal from Pure or Reflected damage.

ward_dispenser.desc_loc:
Use: Plant

Plant the currently active ward. Double-Click to switch the currently active ward.
ward_dispenser.lore_loc: Advancements in stacking efficiency have made wards easier to carry than ever.
ward_dispenser.name: item_ward_dispenser
notes_loc: Hold Control to give one ward to an allied hero.

ward_observer.desc_loc:
Use: Plant

Plants an Observer Ward, an invisible watcher that gives ground vision in a %vision_range_tooltip% radius to your team. Lasts %duration_minutes_tooltip% minutes.

Hold Control to give one Observer Ward to an allied hero.
ward_observer.lore_loc: A form of half-sentient plant, often cultivated by apprentice wizards.
ward_observer.name: item_ward_observer

ward_sentry.desc_loc:
Use: Plant

Plants a Sentry Ward, an invisible watcher that grants True Sight, the ability to see invisible enemy units and wards, to any existing allied vision within a %true_sight_range% radius.
Lasts %duration_minutes_tooltip% minutes.

Does not grant ground vision.
Hold Control to give one Sentry Ward to an allied hero.
ward_sentry.lore_loc: A form of plant originally grown in the garden of a fearful king.
ward_sentry.name: item_ward_sentry

wind_waker.desc_loc:
Active: Cyclone

Sweeps a target unit up into a cyclone, making them invulnerable for %cyclone_duration% seconds. Cyclone can be cast on yourself, enemy units or allied units. When cast on yourself, you can move the tornado at a speed of %tornado_speed%.

Enemy units take %tooltip_drop_damage% magical damage upon landing.
Dispel Type: Basic Dispel
wind_waker.lore_loc: Proof enough to some that unseen forces manipulate the happenings of the material plane.
wind_waker.name: item_wind_waker
notes_loc: Cyclone can dispel some buffs and debuffs.
When cast on yourself, the cyclone can be moved anywhere at a speed of 360.
Cyclone duration is unaffected by status resistance.

witch_blade.desc_loc:
Passive: Witch Blade

Causes your next attack to apply a poison for %slow_duration% seconds, slowing by %slow%%% and dealing %int_damage_multiplier%x your intelligence as damage every second. This attack has True Strike.
witch_blade.lore_loc: A spiteful blade inadvertently possessed by the soul of its incautious creator.
witch_blade.name: item_witch_blade

yasha_and_kaya.lore_loc: Yasha and Kaya when paired together share a natural resonance.
yasha_and_kaya.name: item_yasha_and_kaya
